title: Position: Editing Large Language Models Poses Serious Safety Risks
reasoning: This is a position paper that focuses on security vulnerabilities and safety risks associated with knowledge editing in LLMs. While it discusses the malicious injection of bias (including religious bias) and the circumvention of safety training (unethical responses), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning as a primary research component; instead, it uses these topics as examples of potential risks and vulnerabilities.
